title: 加息竟成：风险资产催化剂？，美联储信誉是关键
speaker: Unknown

segments.en: right and just on your comment on we probably will get a rate hike in about two weeks could that actually be a good thing could that be a catalyst for risk assets I think it's a good thing
segments.zh: 关于你提到的大约两周后可能加息，这会不会是好事？能否成为风险资产的催化剂？我认为是好事。

segments.en: because I think that as I said it's an underlying concern about sustainability of debt which I think will be a problem if growth slows in the states but it's not a problem just yet then there's a question about the AI issues crowding out the month of bonds right that is a bit of a challenge a bit of indigestion problem
segments.zh: 因为正如我所说，债务可持续性是潜在担忧，如果美国增长放缓，这会成为问题，但目前还不是问题。还有AI发行对债券市场的挤出效应，这有点消化不良。

segments.en: but then there'd be more short-term concerns what's happening in the Middle East and also this concern about fed credibility that really picked up over the summer
segments.zh: 但短期担忧包括中东局势，以及夏季以来对美联储信誉的担忧加剧。

segments.en: and I think again with Jackson Hole best and sorry wash was trying to indicate sorry I get confused in between the two of these days that's a bit jet lag but wash critically is sounding a bit more hawkish now
segments.zh: 在杰克逊霍尔会议上，沃什试图表明立场，我有点时差搞混了。但沃什现在听起来更鹰派。

segments.en: is he as we say a hawk in a doving hawks clothes yeah I think that he will have to live at that rate hike and I think that the market would see that as a positive thing to do at this point
segments.zh: 他是不是披着鸽派外衣的鹰派？我认为他必须坚持加息，市场会视之为积极举措。

segments.en: and you mentioned about we've seen a bit of a wash out in the whole AI trade in August what do you do now what are is there just given the crowding out that we've seen across
segments.zh: 你提到8月AI交易出现了一些洗盘，现在你会怎么做？考虑到我们看到的挤出效应。
